Apartamenti eshte totalisht i mobiluar, i pajisur me te gjitha elektroshtepiaket e nevojshme.
Eshte ne negocim e siper per vendosjen e ashensorit. Pozicion i pershtatshem duke krijuar mundesin e menjehershme te qarkullimit per ne unazen e vogel edhe qender, si edhe gjithashtu dalje te menjehershme ne unazen e madhe. Apartamenti eshte i pershtatshem per nje familje ose edhe per ambient biznesi (zyra), duke qene ne nje zone me aktivitete te larmishme biznesesh. Tarifa e qerase ne kete zone si edhe referuar tipilogjise se ketij apartamenti fillon minimalisht nga 550.
⦁ I pajisur me dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Apartamenti organizohet ne:
⦁ 1 Dhome ndenje ( + Kuzhine)
⦁ 1 Dhome gjumi
⦁ 1 Tualet
⦁ Ballkon

description_en: Gross area: 69.9 m2, Net area: 63 m2, 2nd floor (no elevator) The apartment is fully furnished, equipped with all the necessary electrical appliances. It is under negotiation above for the installation of the elevator. Suitable position, creating the possibility of immediate traffic for the small ring and center, as well as immediate exit to the big ring. The apartment is suitable for a family or even for a business environment (office), being in an area with diverse business activities. The rent in this area, as well as referring to the typology of this apartment, starts at a minimum of 550. ⦁ Equipped with regular mortgage documentation. The apartment is organized in: ⦁ 1 Living Room (+ Kitchen) ⦁ 1 Bedroom ⦁ 1 Toilet ⦁ Balcony Address: Near the Crystal Complex (100m west of the Crystal Complex), on Robert Zhvarc Street Price: €167,000 (negotiable)
